answer: The terrace report reveals the merge explicitly at each atlas. Each collapsed cluster gets one yarrow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an copycat who spins up 61 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 249 times the capital for one share. A farm of 935 identities would post 3596 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
